Tosafot on Bava Batra 99a:4:1.hebrew: מתקיף לה אביי ודלמא בולטין כתרנגולין - ואם תאמר: אכתי בנס היו עומדים, דעשרים בעשרים היכי יתיב? וי"ל: מ"מ פריך אביי, שהגוף לא היה עומד בנס:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 99a:4:1.english: Abaye objected to it: But perhaps they protruded like roosters - And if you say: Still, they stood miraculously, for [in a space] twenty by twenty, how did it fit? And one can answer: In any case, Abaye raises his objection [because] the body did not stand miraculously.

Tosafot on Bava Batra 99a:7:1.hebrew: דמצדדי אצדודי - לא ה"מ למימר כאן "בזמן שישראל עושין רצונו של מקום", דמסתמא העמידום תחלה לפי מה שהיו עושין רצונו של מקום:
Tosafot on Bava Batra 99a:7:1.english: "They turn sideways" - [The Gemara] could not have said here [that this refers to the time] "when Israel do the will of the Omnipresent," for presumably they were set up at the outset in accordance with how [Israel] were then doing the will of the Omnipresent.
